apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 184 restores explicit decoder IOSurface alias coherence in both native Metal 4 paths following the return of blocks/tearing on the direct HDR route. Retains Build 183’s single-pass near-native HDR fix and the 2560×1080 Quality stream resolution, three-slot/120 FPS configuration, vibration/controller changes, Mobile Game controls and immersive controls. Targeted simulator tests and Metal GPU pixel/recycled-surface validation passed. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner; resolution of physical phone artifacts requires a same-settings retest.
